seo.title: Flight Intelligence | TripAgent
seo.description: The right cabin, the right fare, route by route from India. Business and first are where we are at our best: the aircraft, the flat-beds, the connections, the award space others can't see.

hero.lede: Flying well from India. The carriers, the aircraft, the cabins that are truly flat, the connections we route around. Business and first are where we are at our best.

pullq.quoteHtml:
Two cabins can share a name
and not a night.
pullq.lede: A guide tells you what an airline sells. It can't hold your fare, see live award space, or rebook you at 2 a.m. when a connection falls through. Read these for the questions. Your advisor answers them for your dates.

routeGuides.heading: Premium cabins, from India.
routeGuides.lede: The routes our members fly most. The carriers, the aircraft, and the call we'd make on each.

cards.heading: The non-stop overnight
cards.body: A nine-hour redeye that earns its flat-bed. Non-stop on three carriers, plus the one-stops worth a look.

cards.heading: Ultra-long-haul, first or business
cards.body: Up to sixteen hours in the air. Where first is truly a suite, and where the best business cabin is the wiser call.

cards.heading: The five-hour night hop
cards.body: Non-stop on a wide-body, often the same aircraft that flies long-haul. When the flat-bed is worth it, and when it isn't.

cards.heading: The short Gulf shuttle
cards.body: Under four hours, flown often. The case for a recliner-style business cabin, the lounge, and a fare that earns status.

cards.heading: Daytime non-stop or the hub
cards.body: A long daylight non-stop, or a one-stop with a better cabin. Time in transit against a true flat-bed.

cards.heading: Non-stop or one-stop to Europe
cards.body: A non-stop overnight, or a Gulf-hub routing with a stronger cabin. The seat against the clock.

cards.heading: The Alpine gateway
cards.body: One non-stop and several capable one-stops, and when the connection is the better seat.

cards.heading: The overnight flat-bed
cards.body: Non-stop on three carriers plus the Gulf one-stops, and which business cabin is truly flat.

cards.heading: The short hop, the right cabin
cards.body: Four and a half hours, flown on everything from narrow-bodies to long-haul aircraft. The trap, and how to avoid it.

cards.heading: The seaplane is the connection
cards.body: The flight is the easy part. The daylight seaplane or speedboat onward shapes the whole journey.

cards.heading: The daytime business hop
cards.body: On a daytime four-and-a-half-hour flight, a regional business cabin and a status-earning fare often beat a flat-bed.

cards.heading: The big-hub gateway
cards.body: A strong non-stop and Gulf one-stops, and the network that makes Istanbul a stopover worth keeping.

cards.heading: The Emirates hub
cards.body: The lounges, the terminal-change buffers, the minimum connection, and the long layover worth turning into a stopover.

cards.heading: Changi, the airport as a destination
cards.body: The lounges, the Jewel, the T4 catch, and the transit that turns a connection into a pleasure.

cards.heading: Hamad, the quiet connection
cards.body: The single-terminal layout, the Qatar lounges, and the short, calm transfers that make it an easy hub.

cards.heading: Five terminals, one plan
cards.body: Five airports in one. The lounges, the terminal changes as they really are, and a calm arrival into London.

productGuides.heading: Read a fare like an advisor.

cards.heading: Business vs. First, when each is worth it
cards.body: The honest line between the two, by flight length and aircraft. When first earns its premium, and when the best business cabin wins.

cards.heading: How to read a cabin by aircraft
cards.body: Flat-bed vs. angled recliner, suites vs. open seats, 1-2-1 vs. 2-2-2. Why the same word can mean a very different night.

cta.headingHtml:
Knowing the seat is one thing.
Securing it is ours.
cta.lede: These guides set the questions. Your advisor confirms the aircraft and cabin, holds the fare while you decide, and finds the award or upgrade space others can't see.
